## Project Overview
This is a URL shortening service built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. The project includes:

- URL shortening functionality similar to Bitly
- Modern, responsive web interface
- Database storage for URL mappings
- Analytics and click tracking
- REST API endpoints
- Real-time statistics

## Development Guidelines
- Use TypeScript for all new files
- Follow Next.js App Router conventions
- Use Tailwind CSS for styling
- Implement proper error handling
- Add loading states for better UX
- Use server components where possible
- Implement proper SEO optimization
- Follow accessibility best practices

## Code Style
- Use meaningful variable and function names
- Add JSDoc comments for complex functions
- Keep components small and focused
- Use proper TypeScript types
- Follow consistent import ordering
